items.title: Big Picard, Borel and Brody hyperbolicity for strictly birationally admissible stable-minimal-model families
items.author: Junchao Shentu
items.difficulty_reason: The complete family hyperbolicity theorem requires logarithmic Hodge-metric asymptotics, Higgs/Finsler curvature construction and a Hodge-theoretic punctured-disk extension argument, then the admissible stable-minimal-model big-Higgs-sheaf construction under a quasi-finite classifying map. All original strictly birationally admissible, quasi-projective base and fixed stable-model type assumptions retained. Three hyperbolicity assertions form one original theorem, not three counts; original stack stratification/log-uniformizability conditions and conjectures remain uncounted context. Old negative-curvature proposition is support, not this complete family Big-Picard theorem.
